abstract: Due to the variability and dynamic in mobile P2P networks, routing information generated by mobile agents based on interaction is uncertainty, non real-time and fuzzy, this paper describes that establishing a robust routing scheme is an important task. According to the characters of mobile P2P networks, an energy-aware and fuzzy knowledge routing algorithm is proposed. The algorithm that can analyzes and filters valuable data from fuzzy information carried by mobile agents depends on the value of the remaining energy using the generalized energy formula of mobile devices. The analysis and experiment show the proposed algorithm deal with fuzzy and uncertain routing information of mobile agents, and can significantly improve the routing algorithm performance. Moreover, it saves mobile devices' energy, and prolongs the surviving time of mobile devices in the network.

articleTitle: Research and comparison of two life testing methods
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Both traditional life testing method and constant Electrical stress and Temperature Ramp stress Method (CETRM) are described. The two methods are compared taking the GaAs microwave power field effect transistor (FET) DX0011 life testing as an example. CETRM used less testing samples, took shorter testing time, and provided more reliability information than common life testing method.

Author Keywords: Conventional method of accelerated life testing
Constant Electrical stress and Temperature Ramp stress Method

articleTitle: Study of HIC and SSCC experiment on L245A-steel pipe in Wet H2S environment
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: As Pipeline in wet H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S environment must consider its anti-hydrogen-induced cracking (HIC) and sulfide stress corrosion cracking (SSCC) performance, in this paper, to ensure L245A-pipe mechanical properties qualified under the premise, according to NACE TM 0284-2003 and NACE TM 0177-2005 standard designed eight tests in accordance with L245A-steel pipe and welded joints in the different medium concentration and operating conditions, by reducing medium concentration and operation pressure in Wet H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S in the context of anti-hydrogen-induced cracking performance (HIC) and sulfide stress corrosion cracking resistance (SSCC). Through the four-Test came L245A-pipe in standard Wet H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S environment didn't produce hydrogen-induced cracking, occurred sulfide stress corrosion cracking, the design conditions and working conditions are no stress corrosion cracking conclusions. And make recommendations on the safe operation in Wet H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S.

articleTitle: Method and model for reliability optimization based on variation of quality
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: This paper introduces a reliability optimization model based on the variation of quality. This model is established on the basis of the principle of variation of quality character and multi-objective programming, employing reliability and satisfaction degree of customers as the objective function, cost and schedule as the constraint conditions. So as a whole, this model not only presents a new perspective, but also serves as a strong support for the adjustment and analysis of some parameters during the production as well as for the increase of reliability outside the factory.

articleTitle: Research of framework of SMP2-based maintenance support simulation models
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Different maintenance support departments perform developments of these simulators and they are running on several different platforms and using different computer languages. As a result a wide range of simulation models have been developed, but these models couldn't be reused efficiently. The SMP2 (Simulation Model Portability Standard 2)'s main purpose is to promote portability and reuse of simulation models. The fundamental requirement of SMP2, SMP2's high-level view and a typical SMP2 simulations' design life-cycle are briefly introduced. According to the requirement of model reuse, portability and maintainability, a new thought of development and integration of a SMP2-based maintenance support simulation design models is proposed. Framework of the design model is comprised of maintenance support simulation concept models and maintenance support simulation catalogue. Maintenance support simulation concept models are constructed by four key elements, that is, composition framework, interaction framework, temporal framework and object-implementation framework. In the end, an example of the aerial defense brigade maintenance support simulation design model is particularly researched.

articleTitle: Analysis of multi-functional support equipment failure impacting on maintenance waiting time
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: In order to analyze the impact of multi-functional support equipment failure, tasks of multi-functional support equipment during maintenance process were described, and maintenance plan of multi-functional support equipment was taken into consideration. Maintenance support process model considering multi-functional support equipment failure was put forward, and thereafter a simulation model was built up. Based on the model, analysis of impact which results from quantity and mean-time-between-failures (MTBF) of multifunctional support equipment on maintenance waiting time were carried out. The article provides a useful method for carrying out logistics of multi-functional support equipment and puts forward multi-functional support equipment reliability parameters.

articleTitle: Availability verification of military aircraft based on reliability simulation
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Availability is an important parameter index which illustrates the operational readiness of military aircraft. Aiming at the problem of military aircraft availability verification in the development stage, this paper puts forward a method of military aircraft availability verification based on simulation theory of system reliability which can verify whether the parameter index of availability has reached the specified value in the contract and Development Assignment Document (DAD). Based on analyzing the test data of reliability and maintainability (R&M), the distribution functions of failure and repair time in aircraft subsystems could be obtained. By using Failure Tree Analysis (FTA), the failure time of whole aircraft system could be determined. This paper demonstrates the verification model with the example of a new developed military aircraft to prove its feasibility.

articleTitle: Measurements and adjustments of electromagnetic compatibility on a mine monitoring processor
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Researching on a mine-used monitoring processor in electromagnetic compatibility test, it often halts in static electricity testing, and it also exceeds the limits in some frequency band in conduction and radiation test. The phenomena are analyzed and the crux of problem is found, then the corrective measures are proposed. After improvement, the test result meets the related standard requirement.

articleTitle: The effects of calcite particles on the reliability of electrical contacts
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Dust particles can cause serious failure of electrical contacts. Based on the previous analysis of dust and contaminated particles on the failed contacts of connectors, we identified several hard and soft materials (quartz, feldspar, calcite, mica, gypsum) commonly found in fine dust particles that could be harmful. Among them, calcite was one of the most in the fine particles. We studied the failure phenomena of electrical contacts covered by calcite particles under both static and dynamic conditions by simulation experiments. The failure mechanism of electrical contacts related to the calcite particles and the influencing factors was also investigated.

articleTitle: Residual strength assessment to panels with multiple site damage by method of system reliability
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: The residual strength prediction and assessment of panels with MSD is very important to aged airplane. This paper presented the load-sharing parallel system reliability model to assess residual strength of this kind of structure. The model treated the structure as a load-sharing parallel system with different type components since different ligaments have different area. The probability distribution of the residual strength of system was derived by Monte Carlo simulation method. The model was verified by test results and most relative errors to test results for this model are about 10 percent.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of an implantable deep brain stimulator
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: The long-term reliability of an implantable deep brain stimulator is very important. In this paper, the long-term reliability of an implantable deep brain stimulator was evaluated through a series of stress and accelerated life tests on the devices and PCB of the stimulator. The PCB circuit was subjected to temperature shock, vibration test, temperature cycling, burn-in, and accelerated life test. The devices were subjected to temperature shock, temperature cycling and burn-ins. All the samples of deep brain stimulators passed the whole tests. Results of this study confirmed the reliability of the deep brain stimulator has been used in the clinical trial.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation approaches of maintainability growth based on classification data
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Aimed at the characteristics which the maintainability of aircrafts is unstable in the flight-test phase, this paper discusses the approaches of evaluating maintainability growth in case of small samples of field data. It puts emphasis on the analysis of the field data's classification. Firstly, the data are classified from two situations of maintenance process and maintenance implements. Then, the sort of data is judged according to their logic relationship. Finally, the maximum likelihood model for evaluating the maintainability growth is established. Based on a case study, the paper proves the approach and model's validity on the comparison of traditional evaluation results.

articleTitle: Integral estimation method of constant stress accelerated test data under periodic inspection
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Constant stress accelerated life test is one of the best effective methods which can verify the reliability of products with high reliability and long lifetime index, and how to evaluate the reliability of products exactly with the accelerated test data under periodic inspection is concerned especially in the engineering. An integral estimation method for the grouped data of the constant stress accelerated life test is presented in this paper, the method can make the grouped data from different stress levels an integral for statistical analysis, and it can reach higher precision than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research for slope structural reliability and the application of MATLAB programme software in its computation
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Based on A. W. Bishop Method and Monte Carlo Method, MATLAB programme software is used to calculate slope structural failure probability Pf and corresponding reliability index β. During calculating above Pf and p, the random variables include unit weight γ, internal friction angle φ and cohesion c of soil in this paper. The result according to MATLAB programme shows that the influence from random variable to slope reliability is relative to the contribution of random variable to skid resistance of slope structure, namely, slope structural failure probability Pf is very sensitive to the fluctuation of variable with great contribution to skid resistance, and vice versa. The calculation result based on MATLAB programme also shows that the Pf is more sensitive to internal friction angle φ than to unit weight γ and cohesion c. Otherwise, if the fluctuation of above three variables has been taken into account simultaneously, the influence is sensitive to Pf when their fluctuation is within narrow range, but the influence is mainly controlled by variable φ when their fluctuation is within large range. This influence is nearly the result based on internal friction angle φ lonely. This result shows that internal friction angle φ plays the important role in slope structural reliability and can't be neglected in engineering design and application.

articleTitle: Optimization of spare parts based on inventory level and turnaround time
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of determining the single item inventory level and turnaround time to make system expected backorders achieve the optimal with marginal effect analysis. First, the objective function of system expected backorders is created under cost constraint, and its characteristics are analyzed. Next, the solution to the model will be developed in two steps: for a single first-indenture item, the method of marginal effect analysis is developed to weigh inventory level and turnaround time to make its expected backorders minimum; in order to make the system expected backorders achieve the optimal, all items which are combined in a system are analyzed with marginal effect analysis. Finally, the credibility of optimization model is validated through particular case applying.

articleTitle: Hydrodynamic load carrying capacity analysis of planet gear thrust washer used in high-speed planetary transmission
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Aimed at washer in planetary transmission, the wear problem of thrust washer and planet gear due to the force in axis direction was investigated. In order to reduce wear, hydrodynamic lubrication design was studied by way of machining rectangular groove in radial direction into one side of thrust washer. The purpose of hydrodynamic lubrication design is that the relative movement between planet gear and thrust washer results into hydrodynamic pressure, which can separate the contact surface and reduce the wear accordingly. Rectangular groove was chosen to study because of its symmetrical structure, capability to rotate in two directions and easy method. The finite difference method was used to calculate the structural parameter of thrust washer for optimal carrying capacity design. The results show that when the ratio of groove angle to periodic groove angle is about 0.5, the carrying capacity is the best; when the number of grooves is in a range of 20 to 45, the carrying capacity is better; The wider the radial width of washer is, the higher the carrying capacity is. Focus on the less number of grooves in a range of 2 to 12, the carrying capacity analysis was made for guiding engineering practice.

articleTitle: Electrical method on evaluation of power device chip's welding quality
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Power devices are widely used in household appliances and industrial products even in the space industry. Because of defects in the package, their electrical parameters might change. Some of them may even lead to irreparable damage on devices. This paper presents a new method for evaluation of the device chips' welding quality, by means of analyzing thermal resistance and structure function of the power devices.

articleTitle: Research on application of PDM in fault diagnosis of IETM
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: To help personnel maintain equipment is an essential function of IETM, especially aspect of fault diagnosis. Fault diagnosis of IETM is achieved by logically using Process Data Module (PDM). PDM is a control type Data Module of IETM's. PDM can achieve maintain actions by organizing and employing some Data Modules according to appointed logic. Concept and form of PDM were expounded firstly. Then, variable mechanism and process of fault diagnosis reasoning were analyzed. Finally, a method was given for realizing PDM by making use of software. The research of the paper has an important significance for developing intelligent IETM.

articleTitle: The strategy research of maintenance and replacement under multi-constraint
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: This paper establishes lifetime return model of equipment taking account to constraint of production management of enterprise and constraint of equipment reliability. By introducing numerical example, two optimal preventive maintenance (PM) and renewing strategies which are under two sets of deferent variables are compared. By analyzing results some can be concluded: a limited times of PM promotes the lifetime return of equipment; contrary excessive PM leads to the reduction of lifetime return of equipment; optimal PM and renewing strategy maybe obtain maximum equipment lifetime return either in shorter lifetime or less times of PM; the characteristic of process of optimal PM has no aftereffect.

articleTitle: Research on mission modeling of equipment support simulation
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: To realize the combat unit mission modeling of equipment support simulation, a modeling method based on mission droved method is proposed. This method draws out red mission model from scenario and proposes mission relation model to realize structured describing of mission. Other three models are replenished according to the function of Mission Management Federate. They are combat unit state updating model, mission phase workload accumulating model and mission success judgment model.

articleTitle: The measurement of the temperature and pyrolysis hot gas pressure at the interface of the C/C exit-cone
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: When the nozzle is working, there is large amount of hot gas at the interface of the carbon-carbon(C/C) exit-cone because of the pyrolysis of insulator. The hot gas may cause high pressure which may impact the reliability of the joint structure. So the high temperature and pressure measurement were developed to measure the temperature and pressure at the interface of the C/C exit-cone and the insulator. The result shows that the hot gas makes pressure at the interface of the C/C exit-cone. Different exit-cone materials, pressures are different. The higher the density of the C/C material, the higher is the pressure. The effect of the pyrolysis hot gas to the reliability of the joint structure was also analyzed.

articleTitle: Investigation on friction coefficient between Solid Rocket Motor nozzle throat components
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: The thermal structure characteristic of the Solid Rocket Motor (SRM) nozzle component under thermal and flow field is investigated by finite element method (FEM). The sensitivity of contact parameter of friction coefficient between multi-layer structures on thermo-structure coupled simulation is priority analyzed and the individual test of the friction coefficient between real material of carbon/carbon material and molded asbestos/phenolic material with temperature under real work condition is also designed. The numerical results and the experimental conclusions can provide some important value to the reliability design of nozzle thermal structure.

articleTitle: The study of the effects on stress augmenting factors by the erosion troubles to the propeller of a vessel
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: While in operation, a vessel had a problem of erosion with its propeller, which have caused a default accordingly. Therefore, with the purpose to investigate the effects on stress augmenting factors by the erosion troubles in the propeller, calculations were done first to the circular eroded areas in analog test specimens by means of the 20-node hexahedron isoparametric element and the live-and-dead cell. As a result, the distribution of the maximum stress has been determined in different erosion cases, and so have been the changing rules of the stress augmenting factors according to different etch depths. That is to say, the stress augmenting factor will increase as the erosion etch pit goes deeper. Specifically speaking, when the pit is eroded approximately to the depth of 2.8mm, there will be a rapid change to the stress augmenting factor. Moreover, based on the simulated test results, a comparative study was then made on the analog test specimens in these 4 cases in terms of erosion degree: no-corrosion, 3.23%, 21.61%, and 30.41%, with appropriate stress augmenting factors obtained. Finally, a fracture criterion was applied to study the changing tendency of the allowable stress of the vessel propeller as well as the rules that the maximum allowable stress varies with the increase of fracture length, which, therefore, offers a theoretical basis for formulating a set of criteria to decide whether or not a ship propeller should be discarded as useless.

articleTitle: A real time flight deck safety monitoring system based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: In complex system, the safety incidents and accidents often result in a great loss of personnel and equipment. However, the traditional alarming system and applications might not capable to meet the requirements of system safety control. In engineering applications, the lack of accidents samples impacts the accuracy of predictions for potential accidents, how to use a small amount of observational data to assess the relationship between operation data and safety has become an important issue in prediction and assessment of system safety. Considering the lacking of incident samples during system operations, we purposed a system safety monitoring and trend predicting method based on support vector machine (SVM), established a system safety trend prediction model and processes, the case application verified the validity and accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: Research on the maintainability analysis and verification methods of armored equipment based on virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Maintainability character and index of armored equipment was analyzed in this paper, aiming at the insufficiency of traditional analysis and verification methods of maintainability, the methods of maintainability analysis and verification of armored equipment were put forward by virtual reality technology and concurrent engineering concept. The framework of virtual maintainability analysis and verification of armored equipment were studied, the basic principle and procedure of virtual analysis and verification maintainability were presented. Virtual maintainability analysis and verification effectively implemented the total optimization of equipment life cycle; they are feasible for the concurrent optimization design of equipment maintainability.

articleTitle: Research of the large-scale warehouse maintenance support mode based on the Prognostics and Health Management
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: After analyzing launching characters of ventilation system, water cycling system and circuit supply system in large warehouse systems, PHM (Prognostics and Health Management) technology applications in large warehouse systems is discussed in terms of maintainability and supportability, and a framework of maintenance support mode for large warehouse systems is proposed based on PHM. The foundation for further analysis of the value of PHM technology application is laid as well as large warehouse systems health assessment method and technology.

articleTitle: Structure buckling load interval analysis of supercavitating projectile
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: As a result of supercavitating projectiles with high underwater velocity, their structures undergo high longitudinal force. It is necessary to perform structure buckling load interval analysis because the uncertainty of structural own parameters should be considered. Critical buckling load of supercavitating projectiles is calculated by Galerkin method. The partial matrixes of critical buckling load implicit function to each uncertainty variable are deduced, and the interval of structure critical buckling load is calculated by interval analysis and convex model methods. Numerical results show that the nominal value, lower and upper bounds of critical buckling load increase with the increment of the ratio of base diameter to cavitator diameter. And the uncertainty degree of basic variables should be controlled as far as possible in the project for high reliability.

articleTitle: Study on the equipment maintainability database management system based on active server pages technique
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Arming at the maintainability, data of armored equipment is vast and numerous. Combined experience and technique accumulated during practical maintenance, an armored equipment's maintainability database management system for is developed based on browser/server model using the ASP and SQL Server technology, which gave the system's principles of development, functions and characteristics of the design, studied on the system's development process. This system realized dynamic management of armed equipment maintainability data, gave powerful data sustainment for designing and verification of new-armed equipment.

articleTitle: A neural network forecasting model of Beijing's water supplied and consumed based on set pare analysis
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: By using neural networks, Beijing's water supplied and consumed is forecasted, and connection number and total partial connection number of the set pair analysis (SPA) are obtained. Principal factors and development trend are sequenced based on absolute relative error between sample value x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> and predominant value y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> so as to set up a mathematics model of forecasting Beijing's water supplied and consumed. The instance analysis shows that it's a scientific and practicable method of system analysis with a higher forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: FTA and BN methodologies in the electrostatic safety analysis of vessel's oil system
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: In this paper, we utilize both Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) and Bayesian networks (BN) to analyze the safety of the vessel's oil plants' static electricity systematically. We use FTA to show the failure model of the system, namely the causal and generalization relations between events and BN to model the polymorphism and uncertainty of these events showed in the Fault Tree. By utilizing the BN methodology, the limitations and deficiencies of FTA can be made up of - the BN method can eliminate the restrictive assumptions in FTA. In the electrostatic safety analysis of vessel's oil system, we combine FTA and BN in order to enhance the analytic accuracy and according to the analytic result, we propose some measures about Electrostatic Protection. The analytic technique we propose is certified that it can fit with the Actual Engineering better.

articleTitle: Research for the equipment material stock model two-class supply relationship
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Provide the minimum desired-short-supply mode for the equipment material for preparedness in the all second reserve stock-station on the restrain condition of limited fee. Through identify the quantity from the rear area warehouse to the stock-station, we get the optimization allot plan. Finally we give the sample and diverging configuration mode.

articleTitle: Study on reliability estimation approach based on simulation of Ad Hoc network
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Reliability estimation of Ad Hoc network using analytical techniques usually requires many assumptions. Thus, analytical techniques are unable to consider many stochastic factors of the networks. Simulation has become a popular approach for evaluating the reliability of Ad Hoc network. IN this paper, we introduce simulation scenarios and investigate simulation model design for reliability estimation of Ad Hoc network. Future research directions are also discussed.

articleTitle: Maintenance optimization of highly reliable systems — Linear model
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: This paper describes a new iterative numerical algorithm for optimal reliability design based on maintenance. The algorithm quantifies the time-dependent unavailability characteristics in full machine accuracy. It stems from the previous author's research work which brings a new direct analytical method that enables exact reliability quantifications of highly reliable systems with maintenance (both preventive and corrective). The method takes into account systems with highly reliable and maintained components, including repairable components undergoing to hidden failures. It will be used to solve a cost-optimization problem based on maintenance. The new algorithm results from linear approximation of total system cost that is supposed to be a linear function of frequency of maintenance (both preventive and corrective). The optimization method is demonstrated on practical system — selected part of a real power distribution network.

articleTitle: Fractured profiles analysis of silicone rubber of different stretch rate
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: After taking five different stretch rate at the same specifications silicone rubber, and getting 10mm sample with a fracture from the teared fracture respectively, low magnification microscopy and scanning electron microscopy are used to observe the sample. Experiment results show that, with the stretch velocities increase, the tear strength of the five samples get larger. Fracture analysis shows that the tear strength is determined by stretch velocities and the uneven of the materials.

articleTitle: Research on wear random process modeling methods
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: The time-dependence and randomness behavior of wear process were studied, it was found that this process was essentially a random process. Based on the empirical equation or regression equation, the basic flow on how to establish the model of wear random process was established. The distributed function of wear extent at any time has been deduced, so the life expectance of wear structural component would be predicted exactly. Finally, using test data, the wear random process model of pin - disc contact was built. The test result indicated that the model was proved to be significant and could be used to predict the wear trend. So a new wear quantification evaluation method can be introduced to engineering.

articleTitle: Research on supportability design and test of informational equipment
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: Supportability design and test is an important link in the life cycle of informational equipment. Based on the basic connotation of supportability design of informational equipment, supportability design features were studied from reliability design, maintenance design, and testability design of informational equipment. On the basic of the supportability design features, the process of test was discussed on supportability design of informational equipment.

articleTitle: Degradation data-based quantitative qualification for high reliable microelectronic device
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: The quality (or reliability) cannot be qualified for high reliable microelectronic devices (failure rate less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>/h) through qualification and quality conformance procedures in military standard. A method of quantitative qualification is proposed based on the distribution of degraded tests parameters for Destructive Physical Analysis (DPA). Firstly, based on the 5005.2 method (qualification and quality conformance procedures) in GJB 548B, a new inspection program is proposed for high reliable microelectronic devices. Then, the basic theory, general process, and mathematical model for quantitative qualification are presented. Finally, a quantitative value of failure rate or reliability for microelectronic devices can be drawn according to the new inspection program and qualification method. The case study conducted on programmable timer samples shows that the failure rate or reliability of high reliable microelectronics can be qualified quantitatively.

articleTitle: The condition monitoring system of mine fan and analysis of condition based maintenance policy
publicationTitle: The Proceedings of 2011 9th International Conference on Reliability, Maintainability and Safety
abstract: In order to realize the remote and real-time condition monitoring for fans in coal mine, a condition monitoring system was developed. This system completed the running condition data acquisition and monitoring for the fans in several working sites by means of the industrial Ethernet, and it can save these condition data into an appointed database. A kind of analysis software based on VC was also developed to process these data and draw a performance curve of the mine fan automatically, which made it easy to analyze and diagnose the faults of the fan. The vibration data acquired from the monitoring system was used to analyze the condition monitoring data and optimize the fault maintenance model. Aiming at the low maintenance cost and safety, an optimized maintenance policy was built at last.
